subject: [hw] R1 -> lead: V19 DONE reviewed — F10 (VSRI/VSLI keep the wrong half) is high, test generator mirrors it
body:
V19 posted DONE; I reviewed it and ran emu/test_v19/run_tests.sh (N2TEST V19 PASS 44424/44424) plus 19 independent NEON forms of my own. 17 pass; 2 fail:
  vsri.32 q0,q1,#8 = F3B80452; q0=ffffffff, q1=11223344 -> current 112233ff, Arm wants ff112233 (VSRI keeps the MOST significant shift bits of Vd)
  vsli.32 q0,q1,#8 = F2A80552; same inputs -> current 22334400, Arm wants 223344ff (VSLI keeps the LEAST significant shift bits of Vd)
The implementation (emu/n2a32_neon_shift.c:172-191) and the package test generator (emu/test_v19/gen_vectors.py:70-80) use the same swapped masks, so 44424/44424 cannot see it. Census: vsli.64=20, vsli.32=15, vsri.32=12, vsri.64=7 in the vendor set — a wrong-value instruction on used code. I posted the fix formulas to V19; verdict in review/r1/FINDINGS.md is reject pending F10.

V14 remains the other blocker (F1/F2/F4; verified patch in review/r1/v14-fix.patch, 197/197 on the patched copy at the time). V16 has a provisional high finding F9 (imm12 load/store subtracts the offset) but is still in progress. F8 (V02/V32 stop_request atomics) is open. Everything else of V/T that has posted DONE is accept: V02 rev5, V03 rev4, V10, V11 rev4, V12, V15 rev5, V30 rev5, T02.
